title: Intraday Price Reversals in the US Stock Index Futures Market: A 15-Year Study
one_line: In US stock index futures (Nov 1987-Sep 2002), large price changes at the open are followed by highly significant intraday reversals (stronger after large up-opens), but the significance drops sharply after a bid-ask transaction-cost proxy.

findings.statement: Highly significant intraday reversals after large opening moves; present by year and weekday.
Overreaction stronger after large upward opens.
After transaction costs, significance falls sharply; profitability an open question.

reported_results.headline: In US stock index futures (Nov 1987-Sep 2002), large price changes at the open are followed by highly significant intraday reversals (stronger after large up-opens), but the significance drops sharply after a bid-ask transaction-cost proxy.

tradable_edge: Supports overnight_reversal_first_hour_es (and its cost warning); test up-opens and down-opens separately.
